sentences.text: The Intracoastal Waterway is a big part of Florida boating.
Its marks carry a yellow stripe, triangle or square.
A yellow triangle means treat the mark as red.
A yellow square means treat it as green, no matter what color the mark itself is.
That matters where the waterway crosses an inlet channel and shares its buoys.
On the waterway, returning means traveling clockwise around the country: south along the Atlantic coast, then north and west along the Gulf.
In Florida, the waterway runs the length of the Atlantic coast and along long stretches of the Gulf coast.
